lines.text: Zendesk's marketplace is bigger on the numbers it states: 1,800+ apps, partners and integrations, against Freshdesk's 1,000+ in the Freshworks Marketplace. Zendesk also describes it as the second-largest cloud marketplace in SaaS. Zendesk's own figures vary (1,800+ in one place, over 1,500 apps in another), so quote it carefully.
lines.reason: the reader: That the figures vary; advisory note to quote carefully

lines.text: Zendesk reviews every marketplace app and integration against its development standards. It builds and maintains its own Jira, Mailchimp, Shopify and Slack integrations. Its Jira integration lets agents escalate and link tickets to Jira issues.
Zendesk has analyst recognition: it was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for CRM Customer Engagement Center.
Zendesk claims its self-learning AI agents can automate up to 80% of interactions. Its analytics cover omnichannel live monitoring, automation potential and predictive insights.
Zendesk has its own Workforce Management product that forecasts, staffs and manages agent schedules. Freshdesk's cited workforce management route is the Playvox integration.

Zendesk offers qualified startups up to 2 years free. Customer proof is also strong: 80,000+ companies, and a Pair Eyewear CX director said all integrations work well and average chat time is under 50 seconds.
Freshdesk's pricing is published: Growth is $19, Pro is $55 and Enterprise is $89 per agent per month, billed annually. The facts give no Zendesk prices, so make no price comparison.
lines.reason: it says more than its facts do

lines.text: Freddy AI Agent is included on all three Freshdesk plans, with 500 free sessions. The 500 sessions are once per account. Freddy AI Copilot is an add-on on Pro and Enterprise. Freddy AI Insights on Enterprise runs root cause analysis and turns service data into trends for leaders.
Freshdesk includes built-in dashboards and report templates on every plan, with custom dashboards on Pro and above. Multiple SLA policies are available on Pro and above.
Parent-child tickets split a complex issue into linked smaller tasks, and ticket templates are included.
Freshdesk's integrations cover Google Workspace, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Shopify and Mailchimp. Custom integrations can use connectors, templates, APIs and a low-code UI.
lines.reason: it and its facts disagree on a negation

lines.text: Freshdesk is positioned for growing teams, typically businesses of 50 to 500 employees. It offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card. Zendesk offers the same trial terms, so this does not set us apart.
lines.reason: the reader: That equivalent trial terms do not differentiate Freshdesk from Zendesk

lines.text: Which tools must your help desk connect to? Are they among Google Workspace, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Shopify and Mailchimp, or do you need something more niche?
Do you want AI included in the plan, or is it a separate decision? Would 500 free Freddy AI Agent sessions be enough to test it?
Do you need multiple SLA policies or custom dashboards? Those start on our Pro plan.
Is workforce management and agent scheduling a requirement? Would a Playvox integration meet it, or do you want a native product?
Is your team in the 50 to 500 employee range?

On the stated numbers, yes: 1,800+ against our 1,000+. What matters is whether your tools are covered. We integrate with Google Workspace, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Shopify and Mailchimp. Let's check your list against ours.
lines.objection: Zendesk's marketplace is bigger and has more apps.

lines.text: That's Zendesk's own claim, 'up to' 80%. Freddy AI Agent is on every Freshdesk plan, and you can test it with 500 free sessions before you commit.

lines.text: It was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant, and that's a fair point. Freshdesk is also trusted by tens of thousands of businesses and is built for growing teams of 50 to 500 employees. Try it with a 14-day trial that needs no credit card.
lines.objection: Zendesk is a Gartner Leader and has more customers.

lines.text: It does: it forecasts and schedules agents. Freshdesk integrates with Playvox for workforce management. Do you need that today?
